finding.title: Ensure that any data read from I2C registers is properly handled to prevent injection attacks if this data is used elsewhere in the system.
Ensure that any data read from I2C registers is properly escaped before being used in web page generation.
Ensure that any data read from I2C registers is properly sanitized before being used in SQL queries.
Ensure that any data read from I2C registers is handled within the expected bounds.
